title: VIRAL Food Festival, Mornington 2026
summary: More than 50 trending street-food dishes, carnival rides, live wrestling, DJs and market stalls at Mornington Racecourse across the 18 to 20 September weekend.
bookingRequired: Tickets available online or at the gate, subject to availability
suitableFor: Families, groups and food-focused weekend plans
verificationNote: On 16 September 2026, the organiser page confirmed Mornington Racecourse, 18 to 20 September, the programme and entry terms. Visit Mornington Peninsula independently confirmed the dates, venue, session times and ticket destination. The ticket provider confirms its own ticket availability and session details.
editorVerdict: This is the big, busy option for a group that wants dinner, rides and a full afternoon in one place. Make it the main event rather than a stop between bookings.
editorNote:
VIRAL Food Festival comes to Mornington Racecourse from Friday 18 September to Sunday 20 September. The organiser lists more than 50 street-food dishes, plus market stalls, live music, wrestling, stage games and roving entertainment. The ticket listing adds carnival rides, bouncy castles, showbags and games, with extra costs for the carnival.

Friday runs from 5pm to 10pm. Saturday and Sunday run from noon to 10pm. Entry is AUD $5 early bird through 17 September, then AUD $7 during the event. Children under three enter free. Carnival rides cost extra. Buy through TryBooking and check the listing before you leave, because availability and event details can change.

The useful call is simple: make this the main event rather than a stop between bookings. Mornington Racecourse sits on Racecourse Road. The programme gives groups plenty to do between food stops, and the rides make it a practical option for families. The checked sources do not publish accessibility details, so contact the organiser if you need specific access information.
